response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior WHERE peercorr >= 0.149;

assumptions.assumption: 0.149 is an inclusive cutoff (>=), not exclusive (>). 'High peer correlation' with a cutoff of 0.149 includes records with peercorr exactly equal to 0.149.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is strictly exclusive (only values strictly above 0.149 count as 'high')
